notes: ViperTab Student edition launch — high-school workflows. Multi-tab markdown notebook with disk-save (File System Access API), school quick-links (Docs/Drive/Classroom/Khan/Quizlet etc.), due-dates calendar, GPA calculator (weighted/unweighted, Reg/Hon/AP/IB), citation generator (MLA/APA/Chicago via Wikipedia citoid), flashcards. New release pipeline supports per-edition versioning so Main and Dev stay at 1.4.3 while Student debuts at 1.0.0. Banner now handles 3 editions.
